what_changed: The oil slide met a supply shock: headlines report tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, the US revoking Iran's sale authorization, oil up 4-5%, and a Trump threat to bomb Iran or reimpose a blockade. Gold bounced 1% but Morningstar calls it a bear market. The other families are unchanged.

oil_gas.why: The Hormuz supply shock and Iran escalation are a named catalyst at confidence 0.53.

gold_miners.why: Gold is in a bear market with a firm dollar and no NEM catalyst; the $9bn miner tie-up is not NEM.

pharma.why: There is no trial, approval or pricing news for LLY.

copper_uranium.why: There is no copper catalyst for FCX.

open_storylines.name: Hormuz / Iran escalation
open_storylines.note: Tanker attacks, the revoked waiver and the blockade threat. Watch for de-escalation (exit risk for the XOM long) or more supply disruption.

open_storylines.name: Oil price slide
open_storylines.note: WTI was 68.55 at the July 6 close, down 26% in 20 days and back to pre-Iran-war levels as output grows. The shock may reverse it.

open_storylines.name: Gold bear market
open_storylines.note: Gold is down 21.6% from its high with a hawkish Fed under Warsh. Watch for a dovish turn or a safe-haven bid from the Iran escalation.

open_storylines.name: Gold miner M&A
open_storylines.note: A $9bn gold miner tie-up (Reuters Breakingviews). It matters only if NEM becomes involved.

open_storylines.name: Cigar Lake suspension
open_storylines.note: The Orano mill disruption matters for CCJ only if it becomes the leader.

open_storylines.name: Copper to aluminium substitution
open_storylines.note: A slow negative for copper demand.

open_storylines.name: Q2 earnings season
open_storylines.note: Exxon signals a Q2 profit windfall (Reuters). NEM has its Q2 call scheduled. Look for guidance changes.

next_job: On the next decision day, check the XOM long (10-day horizon from 2026-07-07) against Iran and Hormuz news. Then read the new record for a named catalyst in each family and decide long or flat.
